data.narrative:
Maritime Operations Group is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Parker Stratton and Patrick Nanson. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 firms across the sector—2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic. The peer set spans seed and Series A stages.

The peer-median method, applied across 4 same-sector and stage-adjacent comparables, yields a central valuation of $700M. The peer sample ranges from $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A), with Singularity at $400M and UFORCE at $1.0B. This wide dispersion reflects typical seed-stage variance in defense tech valuations, where stage proximity and sector focus matter more than tight clustering. The peer-median approach represents the only triangulation method with sufficient data applicability in this dataset.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. This estimate carries meaningful uncertainty given the single-method triangulation and the heterogeneity within the peer set—particularly the wide gap between the lowest ($125M) and highest ($4.0B) comparables. Key unknowns include Maritime Operations Group's specific technical differentiation within maritime defense, revenue traction (if any), and customer validation relative to named peers. A more granular valuation would require additional financial metrics and closer stage-matching within the private defense tech market.
